free_tier.stated: 2× 2 TB – 2× 4 TB HDD (configured up to 3× 4 TB)

egress.terms: Verbatim: 'Unlimited traffic is included, so you won't have to pay extra.' Port is 'Public 300 Mbps' — the shape, not the volume, is the limit.

limits_note: 300 Mbps public port caps you near ~97 TB/mo theoretical. 32 GB RAM, Xeon E3-1270 v6. Regional availability varies (3/9 regions).
reliability_note: OVH's clearance brand — cheapest way into OVH's network with unlimited traffic.

evidence.proved: KS-5: 'Intel Xeon-E3 1270 v6, 4c/8t, 32 GB, 2 x 2 TB – 2 x 4 TB, Public 300 Mbps, US$19.90'; KS-5-B US$35.50 with 500 Mbps
same page — 'For high performance, most of our servers come with network speeds from 100 Mbps to 1 Gbps … Unlimited traffic is included, so you won't have to pay extra.'
configured options 2x 2TB HDD, 2x 4TB HDD, 3x HDD SATA 4TB Enterprise Class Soft RAID, 2x 1.2TB NVMe

price_per_tb_month: $19.90 ÷ 8 TB = $2.49/TB/mo at the 2×4TB config; ÷ 12 TB (3×4TB) = $1.66/TB; ÷ 4 TB (2×2TB) = $4.98/TB. Unlimited traffic, but 300 Mbps.
notes: 2× 2 TB – 2× 4 TB HDD (configured up to 3× 4 TB)

extras.price_verbatim: $19.90 ÷ 8 TB = $2.49/TB/mo at the 2×4TB config; ÷ 12 TB (3×4TB) = $1.66/TB; ÷ 4 TB (2×2TB) = $4.98/TB. Unlimited traffic, but 300 Mbps.

binding_note: one stream is shaped, and a user's throughput is the shaped rate times the number of streams
